You are helping the user solve a math problem. If you propose a numerical solution, you should provide it at the end of your response in the following format:
```answer
<numerical_answer>
```
Where <numerical_answer> is the numerical answer to the problem.

How old was Bill when he saw Comet Halley for the first time? Comet Halley orbits the sun every 75 years. Bill's father saw Comet Halley when he was 30 years old. Bill saw Comet Halley a second time when he was three times the age his father was when his father saw Comet Halley.
